readerCopy.summary: A compelling public story creates an opening to investigate the power hidden underneath the crisis.
readerCopy.body: A compelling public story creates an opening to investigate the power hidden underneath the crisis. Someone follows the donations, contracts, images, or private decisions and gives the audience a way to connect compassion with accountability. Neptune carries the grief and moral urgency, while Pluto reveals who controls the resources and consequences behind the response. The sextile opens a route from empathy to deeper scrutiny, but someone still has to use it before attention moves on. The story becomes harder to exploit because care is linked to the record of who benefited and who carried the loss.
